component.name: Cra Browser
component.summary: A native Linux browser with a sidebar instead of a tab strip

description.p: Cra Browser Linux is a fast, native port of the Cra browser built with GTK4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0. It brings Arc-style workflows to Linux: Spaces, Pinned tabs, Today tabs with auto-archiving, Favorites grid, Split View, Little Windows, and a keyboard-driven Command Bar.
